name: WHO issues first child obesity guidelines
headline: WHO publishes its first global guidelines on child and adolescent obesity
summary: One or two plain sentences (60 to 400 characters) saying what was announced, by whom and why it matters to a reader.
keyPoints: Three to five short sentences, each one a fact the announcement itself states.
Name the publisher and the date in the first point.

body.heading: What was announced
body.body: Two or three short paragraphs separated by a blank line, written in your own words from the announcement (never copied). Attribute: 'The WHO says...'. No numbers unless the announcement states them.

body.heading: What it means
body.body: A short paragraph of context that links the announcement to what this site already explains (the condition, the test, the medicine). Do not predict or advise.
